He works overseas to support them, returning only for Christmas. It's been years since Runi last felt Nobi's affection; they haven’t shared a kiss or a hug in what feels like ages. As she approaches her 40s, Runi worries that Nobi may have lost all feelings for her.

When he asks her what’s on her mind, she opens up to him, sharing her insecurities and frustrations. As the night progresses, their flirtation turns into a few kisses, with both justifying it as a new form of taboo love.
